resources.string: In traditional math, you enter parameters and get a result.\n\nIn "Understand The Answer", it\'s the opposite: you are given a graph or result, and you must reconstruct the initial conditions!
Determine point coordinates (x, y) from the grid plot.
Reconstruct equation y = kx + b from line graphs.
Reconstruct coefficients of y = ax² + bx + c.
Function graph is shown on the grid.\nFind coefficients k and b!
Tap grid to place a hint point or click "Hint".
Use tools above or enter coefficients k and b.
Use tools above or enter coefficients a, b, c.

🎯 Goal:
An unknown point A is generated on the coordinate plane. Your task is to determine its exact integer coordinates (X, Y) and enter them below.

🛠 Available Tools:

📍 Hint Points (up to 2):
Tap anywhere on the grid to place a blue hint point H with its coordinates.

✋ Drag and Drop:
Hold and drag any blue hint point across the coordinate plane. Its coordinates update live!

🛡️ Anti-Cheat Protection:
You cannot place or drag a hint point closer than 2 units to target point A. A red warning zone flashes if you enter this area.

💡 "Hint" Button:
Indicates the quadrant or axis where point A lies.

⚙️ "Grid" and "Axis Values" Switches:
Hide or show grid lines and number labels to adjust difficulty.

🔄 "New Point" Button:
Generates a new random target point for practice.

🎯 Goal:
A blue graph of an unknown linear function y = kx + b is shown. Your task is to determine slope k and intercept b.

🛠 Hint Tools:

1️⃣ Parallel Line:
Shows an auxiliary orange line with known equation. Drag it vertically. Anti-cheat prevents moving it too close to the target graph.

2️⃣ Line Through 2 Points:
Place 2 green points P1 and P2 to draw an auxiliary line. Click "Show Calculation" for step-by-step formulas for k and b!

3️⃣ Points on Graph:
Tap the blue target line to reveal up to 4 exact integer points on it.

🎯 Goal:
A blue parabola y = ax² + bx + c is shown. Your task is to determine coefficients a, b, and c.

🛠 Hint Tools:

1️⃣ Template Transformer:
Use an interactive orange template parabola y = a(x - x₀)² + y₀. Drag its vertex with your finger and toggle coefficient a.

2️⃣ Axis of Symmetry:
Drag a vertical axis line x = x₀. When matched with the parabola\'s axis, it highlights the vertex formula: x₀ = -b / (2a).

3️⃣ 3 Points on Graph:
Tap the blue parabola to reveal up to 3 points M1, M2, M3. Revealing 2 or more points opens the 3-equation system calculator!
Step 1: Calculate slope k\nk = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1)
Step 2: Calculate intercept b\nb = y1 - k · x1
